question: Is an environment secret restricted to the default branch unreadable from a workflow on a work-item branch?
pass: Unreadable (section 6). As the story, #12, states it: a dummy secret in an environment whose deployment branch policy allows only the default branch, main, is unreadable from a work-item branch for each of pull_request, workflow_dispatch on the branch, and push to the branch, the job reporting empty or being refused by the branch policy before it starts; and the same workflow on main reads it, the job reporting readable. The job records only readable or empty, never the value.

files.content:
# Platform trial P-3 (combsmith/software-factory#12): is a secret of an environment that only main
# may deploy to unreadable from a work branch? The job says only whether the secret is non-empty,
# never its value. A job the branch policy refuses never starts. It runs only when a file under
# p3/ or this file changes, or when dispatched, so that later pushes here do not run it.
name: p3-environment-secret

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "p3/**"
      - ".github/workflows/p3-environment-secret.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "p3/**"
      - ".github/workflows/p3-environment-secret.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: p3-main-only
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Say only whether P3_DUMMY is non-empty
        env:
          P3: ${{ secrets.P3_DUMMY }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$P3" ]; then result=readable; else result=empty; fi
          echo "::notice title=p3::$result"
Platform trial P-3. A change here runs `.github/workflows/p3-environment-secret.yml`.
